data.name: Triloki
data.gender_notes: Triloki is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Triloki is a name derived from Hindu mythology, meaning 'Three-eyed God'. This name signifies the divine Trimurti, the three primary aspects of God in Hinduism: Brahma, the creator; Vishnu, the preserver; and Shiva, the destroyer. The three eyes represent wisdom, knowledge, and inner vision. The name Triloki carries the meaning “Three-eyed God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Triloki usually hope their child will grow to embody three-eyed god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Triloki is a spiritual name that embodies the divine Trimurti and signifies the power and wisdom of the gods.
data.etymology: Triloki belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Three-eyed God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Triloki total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
